## Problem and result

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user. Link the issue, if any.

## Validation

List the commands actually run, their results and the operating system/architecture. Explain any check not run.

For CAD changes, include the independent geometric expectation, units/tolerances and relevant BRep, persistence or reconstruction checks. For UI changes, add a screenshot or describe the interaction exercised. Distinguish programmatic evidence, real interaction and exported-file checks.

## Compatibility and limits

Describe document-format changes, affected references, dependencies or platform limits. Write "None" if there are no relevant changes.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful regression coverage; documentation-only changes have appropriate link/content checks.
- [ ] User-facing instructions or contracts were updated where needed.
- [ ] Included code and fixtures can be contributed; no secrets, private models or generated packages are included.

If this addresses an undisclosed security vulnerability, stop and use SECURITY.md rather than posting details here.
